titel: The Spy Who Almost Stopped 9/11 | Enhanced Interrogation | 3

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst art19.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: FBI agent Ali Soufan clashes with the CIA over torture and missed intelligence after 9/11.
kurzfassung: Following the September 11 attacks, FBI agent Ali Soufan extracts vital intelligence from high-value detainees in secret overseas facilities using rapport-building techniques. Meanwhile, CIA contractors push for harsh torture methods like sleep deprivation and mock burials, causing severe friction between the agencies. Despite Soufan uncovering actionable plots, CIA resistance and White House decisions lead to ignored warnings and tragic consequences.
stichpunkte: Abu Zubaydah suffers severe infections in a Thai CIA black site, prompting a medical evacuation disguised as a military cover story.
Soufan accidentally displays the wrong photo on his digital assistant, leading Zubaydah to identify him as Moqtah and inadvertently link him to Khalid Sheikh Mohammed.
A CIA contractor named Boris introduces enhanced interrogation techniques, including sleep deprivation, forced nudity, and mock burials.
Soufan tests the coffin-like mock burial box himself and immediately reports the abusive tactics to FBI headquarters, earning anger from the CIA.
During interrogation, a cooperative detainee named Karim reveals a planned attack against an oil tanker off the coast of Yemen.
The CIA dismisses Karim's intelligence as lies and proceeds with transferring the detainees out of the country under White House orders.
An oil tanker is bombed in the Gulf of Aden after warnings are ignored, mirroring the tragic oversight of pre-9/11 intelligence sharing.
The 9/11 Commission later investigates the intelligence failures, officially criticizing the CIA for withholding crucial suspect information from the FBI.

clips.hook: An accidental photo reveals the mastermind behind 9/11
clips.text: An investigator accidentally displays the wrong suspect photograph on a digital screen, causing a detained operative to expose the true identity of a high-ranking terrorist leader.

clips.hook: Experiencing the terror of a mock burial firsthand
clips.text: An interrogator steps inside a narrow wooden confinement box to test the psychological impact and immediately experiences overwhelming claustrophobia and panic.

clips.hook: Proving that rapport works better than torture
clips.text: An investigator expresses pride in gathering critical security intelligence through respectful dialogue rather than physical abuse, just before a senior official aggressively interrupts.

clips.hook: The devastating cost of ignored intelligence
clips.text: A senior official watches live television coverage of an oil tanker burning off the coastline, realizing that a catastrophic attack could have been prevented.

clips.hook: The staggering scale of secret CIA torture operations
clips.text: Official estimates reveal that dozens of terrorist suspects were subjected to aggressive interrogation methods across various undisclosed overseas facilities.

beschreibung:
At a CIA black site, FBI agent Ali Soufan is questioning the first high-value terrorist captured by the US since 9/11. But with the detainee’s wounds going septic and the CIA’s patience fading, the window for uncovering al-Qaeda’s next plot is closing fast.
